newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: FACB Fujitsu in multimedia pact.
newsitem.headline: FACB Fujitsu in multimedia pact.

text.p: Malaysia's FACB Bhd said on Wednesday it had formed a joint venture with Fujitsu Systems Business (Malaysia) Bhd to participate in the development of multimedia services for the Malaysian government.

Collaborative Technology Sdn Bhd, the joint-venture company, will be equally owned by FACBNet Sdn Bhd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of FACB and by Fujitsu Systems, said FACB in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.

"Through Collaborative Technology, FACBNet and Fujitsu Systems will participate in the Electronic Government Project...(which is) an important application of the Multimedia Super Corridor," said FACB.
The MSC is a 50 km by 15 km zone on the outskirts of Kuala Lumpur which is slated to be the information technology backbone of Malaysia.
Collaborative Technology will have a paid-up capital of one million ringgit, said FACB.
Fujitsu Systems is part of Japan's Fujitsu Limited group of companies.
